name: OpusClip
price: Free; Starter US$15/mo (monthly only); Pro US$29/mo or US$14.5/mo billed annually (US$174/yr); Business custom
watermark: Watermarked on free exports; watermark-free export requires Starter or above
bestFor: Turning long videos or podcasts into short vertical clips with captions, without manual editing
notFor: Frame-accurate manual editing, offline work, or projects that are not clip-based
limits: Free: 60 credits/month, clips up to 1080p, auto reframe, AI captions, no editor, watermark on export, and clips stop being exportable after 3 days. Starter: 150 credits/month, removes the watermark, adds the editor and auto-posting. Pro: 300 credits/month, two seats, B-roll input, Premiere/DaVinci export.
